يؤتمر (form VIII)
# يُؤْتَمَرُ (yuʔtamaru) /juʔ.ta.ma.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِئْتَمَرَ (iʔtamara)
# يُؤْتَمَرَ (yuʔtamara) /juʔ.ta.ma.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive subjunctive of اِئْتَمَرَ (iʔtamara)
# يُؤْتَمَرْ (yuʔtamar) /juʔ.ta.mar/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive jussive of اِئْتَمَرَ (iʔtamara)
